import urllib.request,pathlib,tarfile
p=pathlib.Path('.local/codex-transcription-research');sha=(p/'commit.txt').read_text().strip()
url=f'https://codeload.github.com/openai/codex/tar.gz/{sha}'
with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as r, tarfile.open(fileobj=r,mode='r|gz') as t:
 n=0
 for m in t:
  rel=pathlib.PurePosixPath(*pathlib.PurePosixPath(m.name).parts[1:])
  if m.isfile() and '..' not in rel.parts and str(rel).startswith(('codex-rs/','docs/')) and rel.suffix in ('.rs','.md','.toml'):
   f=p/'source'/rel; f.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);f.write_bytes(t.extractfile(m).read());n+=1
print('Downloaded source-only files:',n,'commit',sha)
PY
